List available CellTypist models

Source: R/pandora_celltypist.R
PANDORA_list_celltypist_models.Rd

Fetches the CellTypist model registry and prints a summary of all available models. Requires an internet connection (model index is hosted by the Sanger Institute).

Usage

PANDORA_list_celltypist_models()

Value

Invisibly returns a data.frame of model information.
